name: Alltech Yea-Sacc Conc
short_desc: A viable yeast culture for use in livestock feeds.
description: Yea-Sacc Conc from Alltech is a viable yeast culture for use in livestock feeds, including horses. Rates for each type of animal are on the label.

name: Aluminium Horseshoes
short_desc: Lightweight aluminium horseshoes with a toe clip.
description: Lightweight aluminium horseshoes with a toe clip, bundled by size for farriers.

name: Anatomic Brushing Boots
short_desc: Black brushing boots with red straps and a moulded shell.
description:
Anatomic brushing boots with a moulded shell on the inside of the leg and wide red touch-close straps.

A soft neoprene-style body keeps them close to the leg without rubbing.

name: Arnica & Witch Hazel
short_desc: Arnica and witch hazel with MSM and allantoin, for bruises and sprains.
description: A first aid and stable preparation from Equimins with arnica, witch hazel, MSM and allantoin — great for bruises and sprains.

name: Back to Basics Immuno Hoof
short_desc: A hoof supplement from Back to Basics.
description: Immuno Hoof from the Back to Basics supplement range.

name: Beige Riding Breeches
short_desc: Classic beige breeches with a knee patch — correct for the show ring.
description: Beige breeches cut for riding, with a shaped knee patch and enough stretch to be comfortable through a long schooling session. Beige is correct turnout for showing and most competition, and smart enough to teach in.

name: Black Elastic Girth
short_desc: A hard-wearing black girth with elastic at both ends.
description: A straightforward black girth with elastic ends, which lets the horse's ribcage expand as it works rather than being held rigid. Stainless steel roller buckles make it easy to do up single-handed.

name: Black Full Seat Breeches
short_desc: Black breeches with a full grip seat, for flatwork.
description: Black breeches with a full grip seat — the patterned panel runs from the knee up through the seat, holding the rider in the saddle without gluing them to it. The choice for dressage and serious flatwork.

name: Black Half Chaps
short_desc: Zip-up half chaps in black, worn over jodhpur boots.
description: Half chaps in black, worn over jodhpur boots to protect the lower leg and give the grip a long boot would. A rear zip with a guard keeps the pull tab clear of the girth.

name: Black Leather General Purpose Saddle
short_desc: A classic black leather GP saddle with a padded seat.
description:
A straightforward black leather general purpose saddle — the saddle most riders in Kenya end up using day to day. Comfortable enough for a long hack, secure enough for a lesson and a small course.

Fitted on the horse before it leaves the shop.

name: Black Leather Snaffle Bridle
short_desc: A complete black leather snaffle bridle with reins.
description:
A full black leather snaffle bridle supplied with reins — headpiece, browband, cheekpieces, cavesson noseband and throatlash. Stainless steel fittings throughout.

Good leather, kept fed, will outlast several cheaper bridles. In this climate a monthly balm is the difference between a bridle that lasts a decade and one that cracks in a season.

name: Black Skull Cap
short_desc: A plain black skull cap, the standard for cross country and racing.
description:
A classic skull cap shape with no fixed peak, so a silk can be fitted over it. This is the hat of choice for cross country, racing work and anyone who wants maximum coverage at the back of the head.

Always buy a hat that has been fitted to your head. A hat that moves is a hat that will not do its job.

name: Body Brushes — Colour Range
short_desc: Soft body brushes with a moulded grip, in a choice of colours.
description: Soft body brushes with a moulded grip, stocked in a range of colours so every horse on the yard can have its own. Keeping one kit per horse is the simplest way to stop skin conditions moving between animals.

name: Botanica Mane & Tail 6-in-1 Spray
short_desc: A 750ml multi-purpose mane and tail spray.
description: Botanica's 6-in-1 multi-purpose spray: body sheen, dandruff and flaky skin, detangler, insects, wounds.

name: Brown Leather Gaiters
short_desc: Leather gaiters in brown, studded, for a smarter turnout.
description: Leather gaiters in brown, fastening with studs rather than a zip. Worn over jodhpur boots they give the clean line of a long boot at a fraction of the cost, and they break in beautifully.

name: Brushing Boots
short_desc: Brushing boots with a moulded strike guard, in five colours.
description:
Brushing boots with a moulded outer shell over a soft lining, to protect the inside of the leg from knocks by the opposite hoof.

Three touch-close straps keep them secure.

name: Buteless
short_desc: A high strength solution for joint comfort and mobility.
description: Buteless High Strength Solution from Equine America, for joint comfort and mobility support.

name: Buzz Off Fly Repellent
short_desc: Fly repellent spray for dogs and horses, in a spray bottle or a large can.
description:
Buzz Off fly repellent spray for dogs and horses.

Available in a ready-to-use trigger spray and a large refill can.

name: Calavite
short_desc: Processed high calcium limestone, distributed by Tack Rack.
description:
Calavite is a processed high calcium limestone, developed for horses and other animals. Feeding instructions are on the label.

Distributed by Tack Rack, in a tub or a bag.

name: Cohesive Bandages
short_desc: Self-adhesive cohesive bandages in blue and purple.
description:
Cohesive bandage sticks to itself but not to hair, so it holds a dressing or a tail in place without pins or tape.

Tears by hand. Shown in blue and purple.

name: ColiFLEX Gastro-Joint Care
short_desc: A combined digestive and joint care feed supplement.
description: ColiFLEX from Coligone is a multifunctional equine digestive feed supplement combined with joint care. Competition safe under FEI and Jockey Club rules, according to the label.

name: Coligone Balancer
short_desc: A daily digestive balancer for every horse, every day.
description: Coligone Balancer — "every horse, every day" — a daily digestive feed supplement.

name: Coligone Liquid
short_desc: An equine digestive soothing supplement in liquid form.
description: Coligone equine digestive soothing supplement, in liquid form.

name: Coligone Powder
short_desc: An equine digestive soothing supplement in powder form.
description: Coligone equine digestive soothing supplement, in powder form.

name: Competition Number Holder
short_desc: A clear armband holder for competition numbers.
description: A clear plastic holder with an elastic strap, worn on the arm to display a competition number. Small, cheap, and the thing everyone forgets until the morning of the show.

name: Compositi Lightweight Stirrups
short_desc: Light composite stirrups with a wide grippy tread, in several colours.
description:
Composite stirrups that weigh a fraction of a steel iron and will not rust. The wide tread is deeply grooved and grips a boot well, which makes a real difference to a rider who struggles to keep their foot still.

Available in a range of tread colours.

name: Cortaflex HA
short_desc: Regular strength joint powder to support joint mobility.
description:
Cortaflex HA Regular Strength Powder from Equine America, to support joint mobility.

The label gives a four-month supply.

name: Cotton Lunge Line — Red
short_desc: A long red cotton lunge line with a swivel clip.
description: A flat cotton lunge line in red, soft on the hands and long enough for a proper circle, finished with a swivel clip at one end and a hand loop at the other.

name: Dandy Brushes — Colour Range
short_desc: Stiff dandy brushes in a choice of colours.
description: Stiff-bristled dandy brushes for mud and dried sweat, stocked in several colours. A hard-working brush that earns its keep on a wet-season yard.

name: Davis Hoof Treatment Boot
short_desc: A rigid treatment boot for soaking or protecting a poulticed hoof.
description:
A rigid plastic boot from Davis, made in the USA, that holds a soak or a poultice against the hoof and keeps it clean while it works.

An adjustable strap fastens it at the pastern.

name: Devils Claw Gel
short_desc: An easily absorbed, cooling devils claw gel for joints.
description: An easy-to-apply joint gel from Equimins that is quickly absorbed through the skin, very cooling and soothing, using the properties of devils claw herb.

name: Devils Claw Root Herb
short_desc: Devils claw root herb in an Equimins eco pack.
description: Devils claw root herb from Equimins, in a resealable eco pack, for joint support.

name: Dressage Square — Black
short_desc: A square-cut dressage pad in black, for schooling.
description: A square-cut dressage pad in black — the everyday schooling pad, keeping the white one clean for competition day.

name: Dressage Square — White
short_desc: A crisp white dressage square for the competition ring.
description:
A square-cut dressage pad in white — correct turnout for a dressage test and smart enough for a clinic. Quilted cotton with a wicking lining that pulls sweat away from the back.

Washes clean without going grey, which is more than can be said for some.

name: Dubbin
short_desc: Moore’s Quality dubbin, 500ml.
description: Dubbin from Moore's Quality for leather.

name: Dudu-Krin Fly Repellent
short_desc: A 250ml fly repellent concentrate for horses.
description:
A fly repellent for horses, supplied as a 5% emulsifiable concentrate.

Ingredients as labelled: E. citriodora, piperonyl butoxide, DEET, sumithrin, soap and emulsifier.

name: Electrolyte Paste Oral Syringe
short_desc: Electrolyte paste in a ready-to-use oral syringe.
description: Electrolyte paste in an oral syringe, for giving electrolytes directly by mouth when a horse will not drink.

name: Electrolytes
short_desc: Electrolytes with vitamins and minerals, distributed by Tack Rack.
description:
Electrolytes with vitamins and minerals, to replace the salts lost in sweat. Added to feed or drinking water.

Distributed by Tack Rack, in a tub or a bag.

name: Endeavon Biotin Supplement H
short_desc: A biotin supplement for horses, distributed by Tack Rack.
description:
Endeavon Biotin Supplement H for horses. Store below 30°C, in a cool, dry place.

Distributed by Tack Rack.

name: Endeavon Lemon Shampoo
short_desc: Lemon shampoo from Endeavon, in three sizes.
description:
Endeavon lemon shampoo for horses, distributed by Tack Rack.

Available in a large can and two bottle sizes.

name: Endeavon Sole Hardener
short_desc: An Endeavon spray to harden soft soles.
description: Endeavon Sole Hardener, applied from a spray bottle to toughen soft or thin soles. Read the warnings on the label before use.

name: Epsom Salts
short_desc: Magnesium sulphate heptahydrate, distributed by Tack Rack.
description:
Epsom salts (magnesium sulphate heptahydrate). Use as required and keep dry.

Distributed by Tack Rack, in a tub or a bag.

name: Equimins Aloe Vera Gel

description: A soothing first aid and stable gel from Equimins for skin disorders, with aloe vera.

description: B-Plus Liquid from the Equimins performance range, a B vitamin supplement to aid recovery after illness and to stimulate appetite.

short_desc: An Equimins spray to help repel biting flies, midges and mosquitoes.
description: A fly and midge repellent spray from Equimins, formulated to help repel biting flies, midges and mosquitoes.

name: Equimins Garlic & Mint

description: A garlic and mint feed supplement from Equimins, supplied in a clear bag.

description: Garlic Extract Liquid from the Equimins nutrition range, a complementary feedstuff for horses.

name: Equimins Milk Thistle

description: Milk thistle from the Equimins nutrition range, in a resealable eco pack.

name: Equimins Respiratory Air Power Booster
short_desc: A soothing blend of natural ingredients for the respiratory system.
description: Respiratory Air Power Booster from Equimins, a soothing blend of natural ingredients to help with coughs and blocked airways.

name: Equimins Ultra Silky Detangler
short_desc: A silky detangling spray for manes and tails.
description: Ultra Silky Detangler from the Equimins grooming line, sprayed on to loosen tangles in manes and tails before brushing.

name: Equimins Vitamin E & Selenium
short_desc: A vitamin E and selenium supplement for horses in hard training.
description: A vitamin E and selenium supplement from Equimins, for increased stamina in horses in hard training.

name: Equimins Young Stock Formula
short_desc: A supplement for mares, foals and growing young horses.
description: Young Stock Formula Supplement from Equimins' mare, foal and old range — advanced nutrition for young foals and growing horses.

name: Equine America Biotin Xtra
short_desc: A hoof care powder with biotin, zinc and methionine.
description:
Biotin Xtra Powder from Equine America, fortified with zinc and methionine to support hoof health.

The label gives a 50-day supply.

name: Equine America Focus
short_desc: A powder to support concentration, relaxation and hormonal balance.
description:
Focus Powder from Equine America, to support concentration, relaxation and hormonal balance.

The label gives a 30-day supply.

name: Equine America Magnitude
short_desc: A behavioural powder for a more relaxed horse.
description:
Magnitude Powder from Equine America, for a more relaxed horse. Helps reduce nervous tension.

The label gives a six-month supply.

name: Equine America No More Moods
short_desc: A behavioural solution for moody mares and temperamental horses.
description: No More Moods Solution from Equine America, nutritional support for moody mares and temperamental stallions.

name: Equine America So-Kalm Paste
short_desc: A paste to support concentration and focus.
description: So-Kalm paste from Equine America, to support concentration and focus.

name: Ezi-Groom Body Brush
short_desc: A soft body brush with a chunky grip, from the Ezi-Groom range.
description:
A soft-bristled body brush on a moulded grip that is genuinely easier to hold than a traditional wooden back — particularly for children and for anyone with cold hands on an early morning.

Used with a curry comb to lift dust out of the coat and lay it flat.

name: Ezi-Groom Dandy Brush
short_desc: A stiff dandy brush for lifting mud and dried sweat.
description:
A stiff-bristled dandy brush for getting dried mud and sweat off the coat before you start with the softer brushes. The moulded grip takes the effort out of it.

Too stiff for the face or any clipped area — keep it for the body and legs.

name: Ezi-Groom Plaiting Bands
short_desc: Plaiting bands in white and black, sold by the bag.
description:
Plaiting bands for manes and tails, sold in generous bags. White for a light mane, black for a dark one — matched properly they disappear completely in the plait.

Buy more than you think you need; they are never where you left them.

name: Feed Scoop — Colour Range
short_desc: A round plastic feed scoop with a long handle, in several colours.
description:
A deep round feed scoop with a long, easy-grip handle.

Shown in black, green, purple, orange and red — one colour per horse keeps the feeds straight.

name: Fleece Lined Girth
short_desc: A girth lined with soft fleece, for horses prone to girth galls.
description:
A girth with a soft fleece lining against the horse. The fleece spreads the pressure and stops the rubbing that causes girth galls, which makes it a sensible choice for a thin-skinned horse or one coming back into work.

The lining comes off and washes.

name: Flex-O-Joint
short_desc: A joint supplement for horses and dogs, distributed by Tack Rack.
description:
Flex-O-Joint is a vitamin supplement for horses and dogs, with chondroitin sulphate, glucosamine, MSM and vitamin C.

The label recommends 50g a day for 30 days. Distributed by Tack Rack.

name: Flexible Tub — Orange
short_desc: A deep, flexible plastic tub with two handles.
description: A deep, flexible plastic tub with two carry handles — for water, feed or carrying kit round the yard. It will not crack if it is trodden on.

name: FlyGuard Pro Fine Mesh Fly Mask
short_desc: A fine mesh fly mask with ear holes and a contoured nose.
description: A fine mesh fly mask from the FlyGuard Pro range, with ear holes and a contoured nose. The mesh blocks around 70% of UV on average.

name: Glucosamine HCl 12,000
short_desc: Extra strength glucosamine powder with MSM and hyaluronic acid.
description:
Glucosamine HCl 12,000 Xtra Strength Powder from Equine America, for equine joint support, with MSM and hyaluronic acid.

The label gives a 66-day supply.

name: Glycerine Leather & Saddle Soap
short_desc: A bar of Moore’s Quality glycerine leather and saddle soap.
description: A bar of glycerine leather and saddle soap from Moore's Quality, for everyday cleaning of saddles and bridles.

name: Gold Label Mane, Coat & Tail Lotion
short_desc: A show lotion that imparts a quick, healthy shine, in two sizes.
description:
Gold Label Mane, Coat & Tail Lotion for show animals. Imparts a quick, healthy shine and assists in removing stains, knots and tangles.

Available as a 500ml spray and a 2.5 litre refill.

name: Hat Silk — Red
short_desc: A plain red hat silk for a skull cap.
description: A plain red hat silk that pulls over a skull cap. Bright, easy to spot across a cross country course, and a simple way to run yard colours.

name: Havana Leather Snaffle Bridle
short_desc: The same bridle in warm havana brown leather.
description:
A complete snaffle bridle in havana brown leather with stainless steel fittings. Brown tack suits a bay or chestnut particularly well and is correct for hunting and most showing classes.

Supplied with matching reins.

name: Heal-O-Fast Wound Healing Spray
short_desc: A herbal wound healing spray.
description: Heal-O-Fast Herbal wound healing spray, sprayed straight on to the wound.

name: Herbal Cooling Gel
short_desc: A herbal cooling gel for fast relief from inflammation and sore muscles.
description: Moore's Quality Herbal Cooling Gel, for fast relief from inflammation and sore muscles.

name: HKM Velvet Riding Hat
short_desc: A traditional black velvet riding hat with a fixed peak.
description:
The traditional show hat: black velvet finish with a fixed peak and a neat, low profile. Correct turnout for the show ring, Pony Club and everyday schooling.

Supplied by HKM.

name: Hoof Oil
short_desc: Hoof oil distributed by Tack Rack, in two bottle sizes.
description:
Hoof oil brushed on to the wall and sole to help keep the hoof in good condition and looking smart.

Distributed by Tack Rack from our shop on Ngong Road.

name: HY Grooming and Tack Box
short_desc: A sturdy plastic tack box with a lift-out tray and a lockable catch.
description:
A hard-wearing plastic grooming and tack box with a metal catch and a lift-out tray inside, so brushes stay on top and the heavier items sit underneath. Stackable, which matters in a crowded tack room.

Available in a range of lid colours.

name: HY Health Hoof Poultice
short_desc: A pack of three ready-made hoof poultices from HY Health.
description:
Ready-made, all-purpose hoof poultices from HY Health's first aid range — 100% natural and veterinary approved.

Three to a pack.

name: HY Leather Jodhpur Boots — Black
short_desc: Black leather jodhpur boots with elasticated sides.
description:
Leather jodhpur boots in black, with elasticated side gussets and a pull tab so they go on easily. Worn on their own for schooling or under half chaps for longer work.

A proper leather boot will mould to the foot and last; a synthetic one rarely does either.

name: HY Leather Jodhpur Boots — Brown
short_desc: The same leather jodhpur boot in warm brown.
description: Leather jodhpur boots in brown, with elasticated sides and a pull tab. Brown boots suit brown tack and are the traditional choice for showing and Pony Club.

name: Hydrophane Cribox
short_desc: A paste that prevents crib-biting, in two sizes.
description:
Cribox from Hydrophane prevents crib-biting.

Available in 450g and 225g tubs.

name: Jeffries Elite Leather Saddle
short_desc: A havana brown English saddle, hand finished, with the Elite embossing.
description:
A traditional English saddle in rich havana brown leather from Jeffries, one of the long-standing Walsall saddlery names. The Elite model is hand finished, with a warm, deep colour that comes up beautifully with regular feeding.

A saddle of this quality is a long-term purchase. It is worth having it fitted properly and re-checked as the horse changes shape.

name: Keratex 3P Hoof Repair
short_desc: A Keratex repair compound that rebuilds damaged or missing hoof horn.
description:
Keratex 3P Hoof Repair rebuilds hooves after damage or surgery and fills areas of missing horn.

Full instructions are included in the pack.

name: Keratex Frog Power Cleanser
short_desc: A Keratex cleanser for problems in the frog, with tea tree oil.
description: A powerful cleanser from Keratex to address problems in the frog, with soothing tea tree oil. The nozzle puts it straight into the clefts.

name: Keratex Hoof Moisturiser
short_desc: Keratex hoof moisturiser for dry, cracked hooves.
description: Keratex Hoof Moisturiser for dry, cracked hooves — made to keep moisture levels right through dry spells and seasonal changes.

name: Keratex Hoof Putty
short_desc: A flexible Keratex wax that seals cavities and punctured soles.
description: A flexible, semi-permanent wax from Keratex that seals and stabilises horn separation cavities and punctured soles.

name: Keratex Nail Hole Damage Repair
short_desc: A penetrating Keratex liquid for damage around nail holes.
description: A highly penetrating, cleansing liquid from Keratex to help repair damage around nail holes and stop old nail holes cracking and breaking up the hoof.

name: Keratex Zeolite
short_desc: A Keratex feed supplement; one tub gives up to three months’ supply.
description: Keratex Zeolite. According to the label, one tub gives up to three months' supply.

name: Korsteel Stainless Steel Stirrup Irons
short_desc: Solid stainless steel irons from Korsteel, with a wide tread.
description:
Solid stainless steel stirrup irons from Korsteel — heavy enough to hang correctly and find again if you lose one, and hard-wearing enough to last for years.

Always buy irons that leave roughly a centimetre either side of the boot. Too narrow and the foot jams; too wide and it can slide right through.

name: Leather Bib Martingale
short_desc: A bib martingale in brown leather, safer than a standing pair.
description:
A bib martingale — a running martingale with a leather bib filling the space between the two straps, so the horse cannot get a foreleg caught through it. Standard for racing and cross country for exactly that reason.

Brown leather with stainless fittings.

name: Leather Draw Reins
short_desc: Draw reins for schooling, with clips at both ends.
description:
Draw reins for schooling work, running from the girth through the bit rings back to the rider's hand. Used correctly and briefly they can help a horse find a rounder outline; used badly they teach it to lean.

Please speak to us, or to your instructor, before schooling in them.

name: Leather Dressing
short_desc: Moore’s Quality leather dressing that softens and preserves, 1 litre.
description: Leather dressing from Moore's Quality that softens and preserves leather. Directions are on the label.

name: Leather Soap
short_desc: Moore’s Quality leather soap, 500ml.
description: Leather soap from Moore's Quality, in a 500ml tub.

name: Leg Gel
short_desc: A cool, refreshing leg gel with camphor and menthol.
description: A first aid and stable leg gel from Equimins, ideal for use after training or exercise. Contains camphor and menthol.

name: LeMieux Hat Silk
short_desc: A navy hat silk with a pom-pom, from LeMieux.
description:
A hat silk that pulls over a skull cap to smarten it up and keep the sun off. Navy with a contrast peak and a pom-pom on top.

A silk is also the easiest way to show yard or team colours.

name: Lincoln Blood Tonic
short_desc: An iron-rich tonic with yucca and kelp, in two sizes.
description:
Blood Tonic from Lincoln, with yucca and kelp — iron rich, to support red blood cells, energy and vitality.

Available in a large can and a 1 litre dosing bottle.

name: Lincoln Sun Bloc
short_desc: A water-resistant UVA and UVB sunscreen with aloe vera.
description: An effective, water-resistant UV sunscreen from Lincoln, with aloe vera. Filters, protects and soothes — worth having for pink noses under the Kenyan sun.

name: Loose Ring Jointed Snaffle
short_desc: A single-jointed loose ring snaffle in stainless steel.
description: The most widely used bit there is: a single-jointed loose ring snaffle in stainless steel. Simple, mild in a quiet hand, and the right starting point for most horses.

name: Lunge Whip
short_desc: A long lunge whip for groundwork.
description: A long lunge whip for working a horse on a circle. Used to guide and position rather than to chase — the length is there so you can stay at the centre of the circle and still direct the horse.

name: Lunging Cavesson
short_desc: A padded lunging cavesson, fleece lined at the noseband and headpiece.
description:
A lunging cavesson for groundwork, with grey fleece padding over the noseband and headpiece so it does not rub on a horse being worked on a circle.

Brass fittings throughout.

name: Mane and Tail Brush
short_desc: A cushioned brush for working through mane and tail without breaking hair.
description:
A cushioned brush with rounded pins for working through a mane and tail. Start at the bottom and work up, and you will keep far more tail than you will with a comb.

Available in several colours.

name: Matt Black Vented Riding Helmet
short_desc: A modern low-profile helmet with front venting, in matt black.
description:
A modern riding helmet with a low, clean profile and front vents that make a real difference schooling in the sun. The matt black finish is understated and does not show dust the way a gloss shell does.

A good everyday helmet for schooling, hacking and lessons.

name: Medi-Boot
short_desc: A tough fabric poultice boot that holds a dressing on the hoof.
description: A hard-wearing fabric boot that draws closed around the pastern, holding a poultice or dressing on the hoof and keeping it clean.

name: Mineral Licks
short_desc: Mineral licks and stock lick mix, including Maclik and Morendat.
description:
Mineral blocks and stock lick mix for the stable or paddock.

Shown here: Morendat Stock Lick Mineral Mix, Maclik Plus, and Ideal Block and Maclik mineral bricks.

name: Moore’s Aloe Vera Shampoo
short_desc: Moore’s Quality aloe vera shampoo, 1 litre.
description: Aloe vera shampoo from Moore's Quality, for washing horses.

name: MSM Cream
short_desc: An Equimins MSM cream from the first aid and stable range.
description: A first aid and stable cream from Equimins, made with MSM.

name: Muscle Up
short_desc: A muscle supplement from Back to Basics.
description: Muscle Up from the Back to Basics supplement range.

name: Natural Clay
short_desc: A cooling natural clay dressing, distributed by Tack Rack.
description:
A non-irritating, natural dressing that is extra cooling and soothing, and helps in the relief of minor soreness and stiffness caused by over-exertion.

Distributed by Tack Rack, in a tub and a larger bucket.

name: Navy Riding Breeches
short_desc: Navy breeches with a contrast panel, for schooling.
description: Navy breeches with a bright contrast panel down the leg — a schooling breech rather than a competition one, and hard-wearing enough for daily use.

name: Neoprene Overreach Boots
short_desc: Soft neoprene overreach boots, lighter and quieter than rubber.
description: Soft overreach boots with a red strike panel, lighter and quieter than rubber, protecting the heel and coronet from the hind feet.

name: Non-Slip Gel Pad
short_desc: A dimpled black gel pad that stops the saddle slipping.
description:
A flexible gel pad with a dimpled surface that grips on both sides, used to keep the saddle from sliding and to take some of the jar out of the ride.

It wipes clean with a damp cloth.

name: Nylon Headcollar — Colour Range
short_desc: An adjustable nylon headcollar with brass fittings, in several colours.
description:
A hard-wearing nylon headcollar with brass buckles and rings, adjustable at the headpiece and noseband.

Shown here in red, black and royal blue.

name: Optima Horseshoe Nails
short_desc: Optima horseshoe nails, boxed, in several head types and sizes.
description:
Horseshoe nails from Optima for farriers, sold by the box.

Shown here in E-3, E-4, Crown Head and ASV patterns.

name: Organic Neem Oil Shampoo & Conditioner
short_desc: Organic neem oil shampoo and conditioner with apple fragrance.
description:
Calro organic neem oil shampoo and conditioner with apple fragrance, carrying the Tack Rack label.

Available in 5 litre and 1 litre sizes.

name: Padded Anti-Chafe Girth
short_desc: A shaped, padded girth designed to reduce rubbing behind the elbow.
description:
A shaped girth with a padded, textured lining that grips without chafing. The curve behind the elbow gives the horse room to move its foreleg freely, which matters a great deal to a horse that jumps.

One of the more worthwhile upgrades you can make to an otherwise ordinary set of tack.

name: Peacock Safety Stirrup Irons
short_desc: Safety irons with a rubber release band — the sensible choice for children.
description:
Peacock safety irons have a rubber band on the outside instead of a solid branch, so if a rider comes off the band releases and the foot comes free rather than being dragged.

We would put every child on these, and plenty of adults too.

name: Plastic Curry Comb
short_desc: A plastic curry comb with an adjustable hand strap.
description:
A plastic curry comb used in a circular motion to lift dust, loose hair and scurf out of the coat before body brushing. The adjustable strap holds it against the palm so you are not gripping it all the way round the horse.

The single most useful item in any grooming kit.

name: Plastic Curry Combs — Colour Range
short_desc: Plastic curry combs with a hand strap, in a choice of colours.
description: The same plastic curry comb with an adjustable hand strap, stocked in a range of colours. Useful for colour-coding a kit per horse on a busy yard.

name: Prolite Saddle Pad
short_desc: A shaped black Prolite pad with a spine channel, worn under the saddle.
description:
A shaped pad from Prolite, cut to follow the saddle and split down the spine so it stays off the horse's back.

Bring the saddle in and we will check how the pad changes the fit before you buy.

name: Quilted Bandage Pads
short_desc: White quilted pads to wear under stable and travel bandages.
description:
Quilted pads that go under a stable or travel bandage, spreading the pressure evenly down the leg.

Sold as a set.

name: Quilted GP Numnah — Black
short_desc: A shaped GP numnah in black — the one that always looks tidy.
description: A shaped GP numnah in black. It does not show dust or a stray hoof mark the way a white one does, which makes it the pad most people reach for day to day.

name: Quilted GP Numnah — Navy
short_desc: A shaped GP numnah in navy.
description: A shaped GP numnah in navy, quilted cotton with a soft lining and girth and billet straps.

name: Quilted GP Numnah — Red
short_desc: A shaped, quilted numnah in red, cut for a GP saddle.
description: A shaped numnah cut to follow the line of a general purpose saddle, quilted cotton with a soft lining and girth and billet straps. Washes clean and holds its colour.

name: Quilted GP Numnah — Teal
short_desc: The same shaped GP numnah in teal.
description: A shaped GP numnah in teal, quilted cotton with a soft lining. A colour that looks well on a grey or a bay without being loud.

name: Radiol Pedicine Hoof Ointment
short_desc: Radiol Pedicine hoof ointment, in two sizes.
description:
Pedicine hoof ointment from Radiol Health Care Products.

Available in 450g and 150g tubs.

name: Red Horse Artimud
short_desc: A clay and eucalyptus hoof putty from Red Horse.
description: Artimud from Red Horse Products is a clay and eucalyptus hoof putty.

name: Red Horse Field Paste
short_desc: A conditioning frog and sole dressing from Red Horse.
description: Field Paste from Red Horse Products is a conditioning frog and sole dressing.

name: Red Horse Honeyheel
short_desc: A honey-based barrier cream from Red Horse.
description: Honeyheel from Red Horse Products is a honey-based barrier cream.

name: Red Horse Hydrohoof
short_desc: A Red Horse hoof moisturiser and natural barrier, in two sizes.
description:
Hydrohoof from Red Horse Products — a hoof moisturiser and natural barrier.

Available in 500ml and 200ml pots.

name: Red Horse Sole Cleanse
short_desc: An active sole and frog cleansing spray from Red Horse.
description: Sole Cleanse from Red Horse Products is an active sole and frog cleansing spray, applied straight from the trigger bottle.

name: Red Horse Sole Paint
short_desc: A Red Horse paint for the frog and sole.
description: Sole Paint from Red Horse Products, applied to the frog and sole.

name: Red Horse Stronghorn
short_desc: A hoof hardening and cleansing spray from Red Horse.
description: Stronghorn from Red Horse Products is a hoof hardening and cleansing spray.

name: Redtop Bait & Bag Refill
short_desc: The refill pack for the re-usable Redtop outdoor fly trap.
description: A service pack for the re-usable Redtop Outdoor Flytrap, containing a fresh bag and a sachet of bait.

name: Redtop Outdoor Flytrap
short_desc: A re-usable outdoor fly trap from Redtop.
description:
A re-usable outdoor fly trap from Redtop, hung around the yard to catch flies without sprays.

Refill with the Redtop Bait & Bag pack.

name: Riding Crop
short_desc: A short jumping crop with a wrist loop.
description: A short riding crop with a broad keeper at the end and a wrist loop on the handle. The length suits jumping and general riding, where a long schooling whip would be in the way.

name: Robinson Veterinary Gamgee
short_desc: A roll of veterinary gamgee for padding bandages and dressings.
description:
Absorbent cotton wool wrapped in gauze, used under bandages for support and protection and over wound dressings.

Cut to the length you need.

name: Rope Haynet — Yellow
short_desc: A knotted rope haynet in yellow.
description: A knotted rope haynet in yellow, with a drawstring top for tying up.

name: Rope Lead Ropes
short_desc: Soft twisted lead ropes with brass trigger clips, in several colours.
description:
Thick, soft twisted lead ropes that are comfortable to hold, each finished with a brass trigger clip.

Shown here in purple, sky blue and black.

name: Rubber Bit Guards
short_desc: Bit guards that stop the bit rubbing at the corners of the mouth.
description:
Round guards that sit between the bit ring and the horse's cheek, stopping the bit pinching or rubbing at the corners of the mouth. Particularly worth having on a loose ring bit or a young horse still settling into the contact.

Sold in pairs, in black and brown.

name: Rubber Guards
short_desc: Rubber guards that protect the saddle flap from the girth buckles.
description:
Flat rubber ovals that slide onto the girth billets and sit between the buckles and the saddle flap. Without them the buckles wear a permanent mark into the underside of the flap — a small item that quietly protects an expensive saddle.

Sold in pairs, in black and havana.

name: Rubber Overreach Boots
short_desc: Black ribbed rubber overreach boots with a touch-close fastening.
description:
Ribbed rubber overreach boots that sit over the hoof to protect the heel and coronet from a hind foot catching them.

The touch-close fastening means they go on without being pulled over the foot.

name: Rubber Sausage Boot
short_desc: A padded rubber ring worn at the pastern to prevent capped elbows.
description: A sausage boot, or shoe boil ring, is buckled round the pastern of a horse that lies down with a foot tucked under the elbow, keeping the heel of the shoe off the elbow.

name: Rubber Stirrup Treads
short_desc: Replacement rubber treads to bring worn irons back to grip.
description:
Replacement rubber treads for stainless steel irons. A worn, polished tread is genuinely dangerous in the wet — replacing it costs very little and takes a minute.

Available in black and white.

name: Schooling Whip
short_desc: A long schooling whip, in a smooth or a braided pattern.
description:
A long schooling whip, light enough in the hand to be used without disturbing the rein contact, and long enough to reach behind the leg without taking the hand off the rein.

Stocked in a smooth navy pattern with a moulded handle, and in a braided pattern with a rubber grip and wrist strap.

name: Shallow Feed Tub — Green
short_desc: A shallow, flexible feed tub with two handles.
description: A shallow, flexible feed tub with two handles, low enough for a horse to eat from on the ground.

name: Shires Loose Ring Snaffle with Copper Lozenge
short_desc: A double-jointed loose ring snaffle with a copper lozenge centre.
description:
A loose ring snaffle with a double joint and a copper lozenge in the centre. The double joint removes the nutcracker action of a single-jointed bit, and the copper encourages the horse to salivate and soften.

A fair, mild bit and a sensible first choice for a young horse.

name: Shires Rubber Curry Comb
short_desc: An oval rubber curry comb from Shires, with a moulded hand grip.
description:
An oval rubber curry comb from Shires, with a moulded grip across the back and three rings of rubber teeth. Used in a circular motion to lift dust, loose hair and scurf out of the coat before body brushing.

Shown in blue, and also stocked in black, red and purple.

name: Shires Stainless Steel Snaffle Bit
short_desc: A solid stainless steel snaffle from Shires.
description:
A well-made stainless steel snaffle from Shires. Solid stainless takes the wear, does not rust in a damp tack room and cleans up with nothing more than hot water.

Come in and we will help you match the bit to the horse rather than to a catalogue.

name: Short Dressage Girth
short_desc: A short girth for dressage saddles with long billets.
description: A short, padded girth for use with a dressage saddle on long billet straps, keeping the buckles clear of the rider's leg. Neoprene lined so it grips without slipping.

name: Sodium Bicarbonate
short_desc: Sodium bicarbonate (bi-carb), distributed by Tack Rack.
description:
Sodium bicarbonate. Use as required and keep dry.

Distributed by Tack Rack, in a tub or a bag.

name: Sooth-Itch Super Strength Gel
short_desc: A gel that soothes itching and supports natural hair regrowth.
description: Sooth-Itch Super Strength Gel soothes itching and supports natural hair regrowth.

name: Stainless Steel Mane Comb
short_desc: A traditional metal mane comb for pulling and plaiting.
description: A solid stainless steel mane comb for pulling a mane and for sectioning it up when plaiting. Small, cheap and it will outlast almost everything else in the kit.

name: Steel Horseshoes
short_desc: Steel horseshoes with a toe clip, bundled by size.
description: Standard steel horseshoes with a toe clip, bundled by size for farriers.

name: Stockholm Tar
short_desc: Stockholm tar for the hoof, distributed by Tack Rack, in two sizes.
description:
A traditional hoof preparation, labelled here as a corrective hoof supplement for horses.

Distributed by Tack Rack.

name: Sweat Scraper — Colour Range
short_desc: A curved sweat scraper with a flexible rubber blade, in several colours.
description:
A curved sweat scraper with a flexible rubber blade, for taking water off after a wash so the horse dries faster.

Shown in black, red and purple.

name: Tamfeeds Horse & Pony Vitamin & Mineral Premix
short_desc: A vitamin and mineral premix for horses and ponies, from Tamfeeds.
description: A horse and pony vitamin and mineral premix from Tamfeeds, included at 2.5kg per ton of feed. The full vitamin and mineral analysis is printed on the bag.

name: Tartan Fleece Rug
short_desc: A red, yellow and black tartan fleece rug with front straps.
description:
A warm fleece rug in a bold red and yellow tartan, bound in black, with adjustable straps across the chest.

Useful as a cooler after work or as a light layer on a cold Nairobi morning.

name: Thorowgood Saddle
short_desc: A soft-leather English saddle with a deep, comfortable seat.
description:
An English saddle in soft black leather, cut for riders who school, jump and hack the same horse. The seat is deep enough to feel secure over a fence without locking the rider out of a flatwork position, and the panels are shaped to sit close to the horse.

Thorowgood saddles are known for being forgiving to fit and kind on the horse's back. As with every saddle we supply, this one is fitted on the horse before it leaves us.

name: Training Bit with Rope Cheeks
short_desc: A gag-action training bit with rope cheeks and a pulley.
description:
A training bit with rope cheeks running through the bit rings, giving a gag action that lifts the head rather than pulling back. Supplied with the cord, pulley and buckles as shown.

A bit like this is a schooling tool, not a shortcut. Please talk to us about whether it is the right answer for your horse before buying.

name: USG Body Protector — BETA 2018 Level 3
short_desc: Certified BETA 2018 Level 3 body protection, the standard for cross country.
description:
A body protector certified to BETA 2018 Level 3 — the level required for cross country and the level we would recommend to any rider jumping at speed. Segmented foam panels flex with the body so it does not fight you in the saddle.

A body protector must fit closely to work. Come in and be measured; the fit matters far more than the brand.

name: Veterinus Derma Gel
short_desc: A 4-in-1 animal skin care gel.
description: Veterinus Derma Gel is a 4-in-1 animal skin care gel: moist environment, intensive skin care, bacterial control and a protective film effect.

name: VetsBrands Summer Spray
short_desc: A spray-on repellent against midges, mosquitoes and stable flies.
description:
A spray-on repellent for protection against midges, mosquitoes and stable flies on horses. Contains DEET and contains no citronella oil.

For external animal use only. Available in 1 litre and a larger can.

name: Whitaker Body Protector
short_desc: A close-fitting body protector with a full-length front zip.
description:
A body protector from Whitaker with a full-length front zip and a mesh back panel for airflow. The zip makes it far easier to get in and out of than a pull-over design, particularly for younger riders.

Fitted at the shop — the protection only works if it sits correctly on the body.

name: Wintec 2000 All Purpose Saddle
short_desc: The Wintec 2000 — adjustable, washable and genuinely low maintenance.
description:
The Wintec 2000 is an all purpose synthetic saddle with an adjustable gullet, so the same saddle can be re-fitted as a horse changes shape or moved between horses of similar build. It washes clean, does not dry out, and weighs noticeably less than a leather equivalent.

A sensible first saddle, and a practical choice for a busy yard.

name: Wintec Synthetic Saddle
short_desc: A hard-wearing synthetic saddle with a grippy suede-effect seat.
description:
A synthetic saddle built for riders who want low maintenance without giving up fit. The suede-effect seat gives real grip, and the whole saddle can be washed down after a dusty ride rather than needing oiling.

Synthetic saddles suit the Kenyan climate particularly well — they do not dry out and crack the way leather can at altitude.

name: Wound Magic
short_desc: A wound dressing for animal emergencies.
description: Wound Magic, for animal emergencies. Worth keeping in the tack room first aid box.
